about: The voyage slice's content: the ONE spec (Docs/Voyages/SLICE.md section 3). Tools/Build/author_voyage_assets.py writes Assets/Resources/Voyages/VoyageContent.asset from it (--check is the drift gate). Rules: Assets/_Scripts/Data/Voyages/VoyageRules.cs. Ids are saved in voyage records: never rename one. Text is printable ASCII (the UI font has no other glyphs). Tokens in titles and lines: {from} {to} {about} {pilot}. Cell is an index into the content asset's cell pool (empty pool: the host cell's own worlds, the ones the Arkway flies).

locations.name: Celadon Harbour
locations.blurb: Home water for the Jade. Dock here and whatever is aboard is yours.

locations.name: Carmine Harbour
locations.blurb: Home water for the Ruby. Dock here and whatever is aboard is yours.

locations.name: Aurum Harbour
locations.blurb: Home water for the Gold. Dock here and whatever is aboard is yours.

locations.name: Tollmoor
locations.blurb: A neutral port where every lane crosses. News arrives here first and leaves here fastest.

locations.name: Lantern Reach
locations.blurb: Vault shells drift here, lit from inside. Something sealed them, and something wants them back.

locations.name: The Hollow
locations.blurb: A quiet cell with deep vaults. Quiet cells are quiet for a reason.

locations.name: Verdigris
locations.blurb: A contested core. Whoever holds its nucleus decides whose colour the waves fight for.

locations.name: Saltmarch
locations.blurb: A core on the trade lane, ringed with old wreckage.

crew.name: Oriel Vance
crew.story: Reads a vault's shell like a face. Has opened more than she has kept.

crew.name: Brisk Amadou
crew.story: Tracks predators for a living, and sells what they guard.

crew.name: Ilse Marren
crew.story: Follows the grazers. Where they gather, something sealed lies near.

crew.name: Teodor Haskel
crew.story: Weighs every find before he touches it. Usually right.

crew.name: Pell
crew.story: Finds the switch nobody else saw. Talks to it, too.

crew.name: Cass Morrow
crew.story: Knows every Ark by its silhouette, and every wreck by its smell.

crew.name: Juno Rask
crew.story: Calls the rival out before the rival knows they are a rival.

crew.name: Sable Okoye
crew.story: Flies the burning edge of a wreck field for fun.

crew.name: Aster Quill
crew.story: Rides the tunnels others fear. Arrives early, leaves rich.

crew.name: Merrin Tal
crew.story: Prices news by its voltage. Fresh news sparks.

crew.name: Dov Ferrante
crew.story: Charts the fastest lane between any two ports, then charges for it.

crew.name: Noor Achebe
crew.story: Never late. Has never once been late.

crew.name: Wren Holloway
crew.story: Carries sealed dispatches for three ports and reads none of them. Probably.

crew.name: Rook Sandoval
crew.story: Knows where the herds will feed tomorrow, and who will pay to know it.

crew.name: Lady Corvina Ash
crew.story: Holds what is hers. Considers most things hers.

crew.name: Marshal Edda Kroll
crew.story: Has held Verdigris twice and lost it once. Remembers the once.

crew.name: Captain Theo Lark
crew.story: Never leaves a wing behind. Never lets you forget it.

crew.name: Warden Sorrel
crew.story: Tends the gardens of the cores, and the guns that guard them.

jobs.title: Sail home to {to}
jobs.summary: Dock at {to}. Everything aboard becomes yours.

jobs.title: {pilot}: carry a sealed dispatch to {to}
jobs.summary: Reach {to} with the Ark standing. The news aboard will change what {to} knows.
jobs.success: {pilot}'s dispatch reached {to}. The dock crews were talking about it before the hull cooled.

jobs.title: {pilot}: open the vaults at {to}
jobs.summary: Vaults are lit at {to}. Crack one with a payload, carry its artifact back to the Ark and stow it.
jobs.success: {pilot}'s crew opened a vault at {to}. Its chart pointed somewhere new.
jobs.fail: The vaults at {to} kept their secrets.

jobs.title: {pilot}: chase a rumour of vaults at {to}
jobs.summary: Nobody has seen them lit, but {pilot} swears there are vaults at {to}. Crack one and stow what is inside.
jobs.success: {pilot}'s rumour was true. A vault at {to} gave up its artifact.
jobs.fail: {to} was empty water, or looked like it.

jobs.title: {pilot}: strip the wreck at {to}
jobs.summary: An Ark went down at {to} and its hold spilled. Grab what floats there with RB and stow it in your Ark before anyone else does.
jobs.fail: Someone else got to the wreck at {to} first, or nobody did.

jobs.title: {pilot}: answer the call to hold {to}
jobs.summary: {to} is under pressure. Keep the Ark under its core until the hold is done.
jobs.success: {pilot}'s squad held {to}. The wardens there owe a favour, and paid it in news.
jobs.fail: {to} fell to the waves while the squad was away.

jobs.title: {pilot}: patrol {to}
jobs.summary: Fly the flag at {to}. Keep the Ark under its core until the patrol is done.
jobs.fail: The patrol at {to} was cut short.

writes.line: Dock crews at {to} say {about} is asking for a squad to hold it.
A vault chart from {to} shows lit shells at {about}.
With the wreck gone, the waves at {about} turned on the core. It asks for help.
The wardens of {to} share a chart: vaults are lit at {about}.

seeds.line: A trader swears the shells at Lantern Reach are lit again.
Verdigris is losing its core to the waves and asks for a squad.
Something is glowing at the bottom of the Hollow.
An Ark went down at Saltmarch. Its hold spilled, and nobody has claimed it yet.

seedWrecks.line: A broken Ark at Saltmarch, its hold open to the sea.

lines.wreck: An Ark fell at {about}. What it carried lies there now.
lines.wreckNews: An Ark went down at {about} and its hold spilled. Nobody has claimed it yet.

hud.BoardOpen: FLY THROUGH A JOB TO TAKE IT
hud.Vaults: VAULTS AHEAD: CRACK ONE, GRAB ITS ARTIFACT, STOW IT AT THE ARK
hud.Wreck: A WRECK: GRAB WHAT FLOATS WITH RB AND STOW IT AT THE ARK
hud.Extracted: DOCKED AT {to}: {count} FOUND ARTIFACTS ARE YOURS
hud.NoWork: No pilot has work here. Seat other pilots, or sail on.
hud.Following: SAILING WITH YOUR HOST: THEY PICK THE NEXT JOB

toy.description: Deploy your squad and sail the HyperSea from job to job. Dock at home to keep what you find.

menu.shellDetail: deploy your squad and take a job from the board
menu.shellUnderwayDetail: give the voyage up - what is aboard is lost
